additional_info.subject: TLRXpf connectivity problem
additional_info.body:
Dear Support,
customer has reported that the Sicharge D, TLRXpf is offline in their backend and I can confirm that it is offline in SCB as well.
There is power on site, there is power for the teltonika routers as well, charger is powered on.
There is internet via LAN, customer has confirmed that they have tested it.
Please check what can be the problem (if you can reach the charger via SSH) or suggest some troubleshooting steps to find the rootcause of this error.
Üdvözlettel / With best regards,
Szilard Negyesi
Siemens Zrt.
SI E
Gizella út 51-57.
1143 Budapest
mailto:

additional_info.body:
Hello ﻿Szilard,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Giridhar
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
: MP / S1 170003161
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
TLRXpf
Problem Description
:  Connectivity Problem (SCB & OCPP Offline)
Troubleshooting
:
We need to follow KA for troubleshooting :
Emobility_SICD_Connectivity_OCPP/SCB offline
We recommend having Spare router while site intervention.
To need additional information from the Customer side in troubleshooting issue :
1. What is the name of the customer backend?
2. If the OCPP Backend Integration Tests have been performed. If not, We need to seek for same at
Backend Integrations (sharepoint.com)
3. What are the values of WebSocketPingInterval, ConnectionTimeOut, HeartbeatInterval
For future reference, your ticket number is
0374211
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
Thank and Best Regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Giridhar "Gary"
